[0] I mentioned in today's article on Siri AI Apple Watch that there is another change I hope Apple will fix before watchOS 27 is officially released. This is a common function I have used for many years and has become muscle memory, and I have missed it all summer.

[1] In watchOS 27, double-clicking the Digital Crown no longer allows you to quickly switch between different apps

[2] I wrote this morning:

[3] When Apple released the first public beta of watchOS 27 in July, I already pointed out this issue, and I had also reflected my opinions back in June.

[4] For many years, Apple Watch has had a hidden gesture function that allows you to quickly switch between two apps, or between the last app you used and the watch face.

[5] I have used this operation for so many years that I don't really notice it on a daily basis, but I use it extremely frequently.

[6] In watchOS 27, single-click and double-click on the Digital Crown will bring up the Dynamic App arrangement

[7] This function was already removed in watchOS 27 beta 1. The reason seems to be that Apple wants to heavily promote the new "Dynamic App arrangement" feature of watchOS 27. Now, pressing the Digital Crown once will display the Siri app icon, plus five smart-recommended app icons, and a button that lets you see the full App arrangement.

[8] I am actually quite satisfied with the Dynamic App arrangement when I use it; if the app you are looking for is already in the recommended launch area, it is quite convenient.

[9] But it can never replace an operation like double-clicking that can reliably jump between different apps. In watchOS 27, there is simply no way to do this anymore. In the watchOS 27 beta, double-clicking the Digital Crown has the same effect as single-clicking the button.

[10] The old method allowed you to quickly switch between apps like Workout and Music.

[11] As I have mentioned before, Apple Watch really has a pitifully small number of buttons; only the Ultimate series has an extra Action Button. Seeing this, I think taking away one double-click gesture from one of the buttons is a mistake.

[12] The double-click function of the side button under the Digital Crown has retained its original purpose: to open Apple Wallet cards. Hopefully the official version of watchOS 27 can restore the same gesture for the Digital Crown, or at least add it back in watchOS 27.1.

[13] Do you use this gesture on Apple Watch? Have you missed it in the watchOS 27 beta? After you upgrade, will you miss it dearly? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
